scenes.title: Distinguish roster roles, staffing and status
scenes.narration: Personnel shows a member’s roles separately from staffing, status, and administrative state. In our fictional Chicago Fire department, Casey begins with Officer, On Shift, Standing By, and Admin. Choose Manage Roles to inspect the catalog. The page lists each role’s description and member count. It also explains how role order chooses an available custom icon for a person’s map pin. We will leave the original six roles and their order unchanged, and add one clearly marked coordination exercise.

scenes.title: Give the role a clear operational purpose
scenes.narration: Choose Add Role. Enter Training Only, Community Response Navigator as the Name. Use the Description to explain the fictional community paramedicine and mental health coordination exercise. Our description explicitly separates software training from professional qualification and system administration privileges. Custom icon is optional and remains empty. A useful role name tells another administrator what the role is for; its description explains the intended scope before anyone is assigned to it.

scenes.title: Save one deliberate certification requirement
scenes.narration: From the new role’s row, open Required certifications. The notice says enforcement is Off, and Member eligibility says the role has no members. Add requirement creates a row. Select the fictional record-review type, check Mandatory, leave Any-of group blank, leave Allow trainee clear, and enter seven for Grace override. Save, then reopen the page and read the same single row. The seven-day setting concerns the removal grace calculation if enforcement applies; it does not change a certification record’s expiry.

scenes.title: Compare independent rules and alternatives without saving
scenes.narration: Back on the role’s requirements page, add a second, distinct type for an unsaved comparison. With both Mandatory boxes checked and both group fields blank, the rows express separate requirements: both would be needed. Give both rows group number one, and they become alternatives: either could satisfy that group. This is a form preview, so do not Save. Reloading restores the original single row, blank group, and seven-day override. Saving would replace the stored requirement set; the discarded preview changes none of it.

scenes.title: Open the member editor and preserve the baseline
scenes.narration: To assign the role, return to Personnel and use Edit on Casey’s row. In the profile’s Roles field, wait for the existing Officer selection to load. It must remain selected when adding another role. Group is Truck 81 and Is Group Admin is already checked in this fictional account; leave both unchanged. This page contains other profile settings, so keep the exercise focused on the intended additional role rather than changing membership, contact, or administrative options.

scenes.title: Prepare the additional role without replacing Officer
scenes.narration: Use the profile’s Roles selector for the additional assignment. Community is entered in the lookup, while Officer remains selected. The prepared selection then contains two complete chips: Officer and the new Training Only, Community Response Navigator role. Read both names before saving. This control submits the whole selected role set, so an existing role must remain present if you intend to preserve it. Adding the new chip is preparation; we still need a saved readback.

scenes.narration: Before saving, compare the unchanged profile controls. Department Admin is already selected, while Disable User and Hide User are clear. We leave them that way. Use the normal Save once. Back in Personnel, search for Matthew Casey. His row now lists Officer and the new coordination role together. Staffing remains On Shift, status remains Standing By, and administrative state still reads Admin. The result is an additional operational role on the same member, not a new staffing or status selection.

scenes.title: Check the role’s actual member and software eligibility
scenes.narration: Return through Manage Roles. The new role now has one member. Choose its View control to see Casey listed under the stored description. Open Required certifications from that role’s row to inspect Member eligibility. Casey is marked Qualified for this single fictional software rule. The Off notice remains visible: this result does not demonstrate enforcement blocking or removal. Read the rule, the member, and the software result together, and keep professional authorization decisions outside this training exercise.

scenes.title: Apply the same careful role workflow across sectors
scenes.narration: Chicago Fire can use this workflow to describe an exercise coordination role. Community care and mental health teams can organize operational responsibilities without patient detail. Search and rescue can distinguish search and support roles; security teams can define site responsibilities; wildland teams can organize seasonal coordination; and industrial response teams can separate staff functions from equipment inspections. In each setting, use clear descriptions, deliberate requirements, and verified membership. Preserve existing assignments and administrative settings, and check saved results before relying on them.
